work_item: B03 route the existing exact polynomial evaluator through input and Core with per-term output
source_snapshot_method: SHA-256 of the compact JSON file inventory in code-snapshot.json

initial_compile_failures.cause: The new parser used BTreeMap without importing the standard-library type.
initial_compile_failures.correction: Imported std::collections::BTreeMap in input.rs; the same formatting, check, Clippy and build sequence then passed.

existing_component_observation: At base commit f0c9041, evaluate_polynomial existed as a public component and was referenced by component tests, but had no normal Core intent consumer.

tests_and_route.reason_not_executed: This continuation did not request test or runtime-route verification; only formatting, compilation, lint and build checks were run.

implemented_route: apps/cli -> Core::run -> input::mathematics_intent -> Intent::EvaluatePolynomial -> math::evaluate_polynomial_report -> exact polynomial evaluator
supported_behavior_from_source: Japanese 「評価 expression 代入 x=3」 (also with 「を計算して」 / 「を計算してください」) and English `evaluate expression at x=3` or `evaluate-polynomial expression at x=3` seal one bounded polynomial expression and explicit bindings.
Bindings are comma-separated exact scalar expressions, limited to eight; duplicate bindings and malformed binding strings produce typed unresolved intents.
The existing polynomial parser and exact evaluator remain the execution engine. Every source variable requires an explicit binding; extra valid bindings do not change the computed value.
The Core report preserves the input expression, variables and bindings and lists each canonical monomial, its exact value and its exact contribution before the exact total.

The prior evaluate_polynomial string-returning component API remains as a wrapper over the new report-producing operation. Polynomial term, degree, coefficient, depth and operation bounds remain active.

acceptance.B03: UNVERIFIED; source implementation and format/check/lint/build evidence only, no test or ordinary-route execution
